description: Last night, I attended the (Sept. 12) League of Women Voters forum for state House districts 49A and 49B. Each race featured two candidates, representing both Republican and Democratic perspectives. In House District 49A, Alex Falconer, the DFL-endorsed candidate, is opposing Stacy Bettison, the GOP-endorsed candidate.
